title: processkit working-copy revision
description: The working-copy revision that a result is attributed to (repository-storage@v1 PK-STORE-041, PK-STORE-062).

commit.description: Full hexadecimal object name of the commit at HEAD (40 digits for SHA-1, 64 for SHA-256 repositories); null when the repository has no commit.

uncommitted.description: true when any served item is uncommitted, or when processkit.toml or processkit.lock is untracked or has a staged or unstaged change relative to HEAD; always true when commit is null.
